title: Topic 2.3: Crop Pest and Disease Control

pages.lesson:
LESSON: CROP PEST AND DISEASE CONTROL

Grade: Grade 8
Subject: AGRICULTURE
Strand: Food Production Processes
Topic 2.3: Crop Pest and Disease Control

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! Today we learn about Crop Pest and Disease Control. Read the explanation, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

Big question: How can we identify vegetable crops attacked by pests and diseases?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. identify vegetable crops attacked by pests and diseases

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

1. identify vegetable crops attacked by pests and diseases
   In simple words: practise until you can identify vegetable crops attacked by pests and diseases. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: Talk about Crop Pest and Disease Control using something you see at school in Kenya.

Example 2: Give a home example from your county, estate, or village.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Underline two new ideas about Crop Pest and Disease Control in the examples.
2. Explain Crop Pest and Disease Control to a parent using one local example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand Crop Pest and Disease Control.
4. Show that you can: identify vegetable crops attacked by pests and diseases

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Crop Pest and Disease Control using examples from school or home.
2. Answer: Why is Crop Pest and Disease Control important for a Grade 8 learner?
3. Make a one-minute oral presentation to a parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SECTION 7: CLASS ACTIVITY IDEAS

1. Control pests on vegetables using methods such as handpicking, removing affected crop parts, uprooting heavily affected crops, and applying natural pesticides such as ash,

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. How can we identify vegetable crops attacked by pests and diseases?
2. How can we control pests and diseases affecting crops?

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. identify vegetable crops attacked by pests and diseases

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open the Answers tab only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Original learner lesson from KICD outcomes (Strategy 2)
